digest.component_or_area: review-bot deployment and persistent tickets clone
propositions: The review-bot's persistent tickets clone on EBS-backed external volume diverges during redeploy because the entrypoint clones only when .git is absent and does not fetch or reset divergent history.
The entrypoint invokes ensure-tickets.sh outside the PAT block, so convergence must run even when REVIEWBOT_TICKETS_PAT is unset.
The autodeploy.sh script omits reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh from BOT_PATHS, preventing script-only changes from triggering deployment.
Artifact write failures after a Gerrit vote is cast must not undo the vote or wedge the bot, requiring best-effort error handling in the convergence path.
A pre-epoch persistent clone with local tip as an ancestor of the prior remote tip must safely adopt the newly fetched epoch-bearing remote commit without losing local-only commits.
